status: working hypothesis — not validated with audience comprehension tests
principle: First translate source claims into typed relations; only then render those relations.
domain_disclaimer: The records encode the contents of traditions, not the objective truth of cosmological propositions.

minimal_data_model.claim: a sourced and paraphrased proposition belonging to one tradition
minimal_data_model.referent: an opaque named placeholder; no claim of physical existence
minimal_data_model.qualifier: time, medium, conservation, scope or modality that disambiguates the relation
minimal_data_model.source: a research record; not shown throughout an eventual narrative

rank.meaning: ordered levels on a stated comparison dimension

mediate.meaning: a source affects a destination through an intermediary

differentiate.meaning: one basis takes distinguishable forms; no presumption of physical loss

transfer.meaning: a specified carrier is said to pass between source and recipient

depend_on.meaning: one thing requires another for a particular function

partition.meaning: an exhaustively grouped set, without causal implications

qualify.meaning: an influence alters or determines a bearer’s qualities

ground.meaning: one item depends on another for its existence; not equivalent to transfer

orient.meaning: directed attention, aspiration, or reference; not spatial movement

rendering_rules.rank: separate ordered strata with dimension displayed; do not infer spatial containment
rendering_rules.mediate: two causally directed links through explicit intermediate locus
rendering_rules.differentiate: fan-out showing distinguishable branches, without shrinking the parent
rendering_rules.transfer: one or more crossing tokens or stream only where a carrier is asserted
rendering_rules.depend_on: sustained support link; if no carrier supplied, no particles
rendering_rules.partition: brackets or grouping boundaries; no motion required
rendering_rules.qualify: change in a bearer’s texture or internal pattern; hue identifies variant but has no metaphysical meaning
rendering_rules.change: before/after states with a timed morph only for world-temporal changes
rendering_rules.ground: static support relationship with stable source; never a particle stream
rendering_rules.orient: reorientation of a locus/axis of attention, not displacement of object

global_invariants: identical words never imply equivalent concepts
different words never imply different concepts without relational analysis
atemporal grounding must not render as chronological creation
the visual representation may not add unasserted material transfer
animation used for viewer reveal must be distinguishable from events within a cosmology
missing qualifiers remain unknown, not silently filled by the renderer
colors may distinguish variants but must not encode intrinsic moral status by default

claims.claim: The Ray of Creation orders worlds from the Absolute to the Moon, with increasingly numerous governing laws.
claims.visual_goal: seven ordered strata; number/constraint increases toward Moon
guardrails: Do not equate higher position with larger physical size.
The integers refer to claimed orders of laws, not empirically observed counts.

claims.claim: Terrestrial organic life mediates planetary influences to the Earth.
guardrails: Do not assume particles or physical stuff is transported.

claims.claim: Organic life emits differentiated radiations toward Sun, planets, and Moon; their requirements differ.
claims.visual_goal: three destination-specific outbound transmissions; not one uniform ray
guardrails: Represent radiations as text-specified carriers, not as known physical radiation.

claims.claim: The Moon is maintained by energies associated with terrestrial organic life.
claims.locator: chapter 9 and earlier discussion in chapter 3
claims.visual_goal: Moon retains state through a sustained incoming channel
guardrails: Does not imply Gurdjieff described a vampiric humanoid spirit.

claims.claim: One divine Life is described as expressing itself through seven rays or builders.
claims.visual_goal: one source with seven branches whose distinct qualities are retained
guardrails: Do not show seven units of matter detached from a depleted source.
The rays are also personified as Builders; do not force a single interpretation.

claims.claim: The seven rays are categorized as three Rays of Aspect and four Rays of Attribute.
claims.visual_goal: a seven-element set partitioned into 3 + 4 without reducing to two rays
guardrails: Do not interpret the two groups as mutually hostile.

claims.claim: Rays condition the qualities manifested by forms throughout kingdoms of nature.
claims.visual_goal: a form changes a structured expressive property under ray influence
guardrails: An effect on the bearer is not necessarily material transferred from the ray.

claims.claim: A person’s soul ray and personality ray may differ and jointly shape expression, with soul ray potentially becoming dominant.
claims.visual_goal: two co-present influences modulate one person, then shift relative salience
guardrails: Do not imply every individual has the same rays or stages.

claims.claim: Intellect (Nous) depends for its existence on the One; this is not an event occurring at a particular time.
claims.visual_goal: stable grounding connection, no departing particles and no chronological birth
guardrails: Do not render a physical flow or loss of material by the One.

claims.claim: Soul is grounded in Intellect, which remains itself rather than dividing off a piece.
claims.visual_goal: stable secondary grounding link with unchanged Intellect
guardrails: No detachment, depletion, or literal physical descent.

claims.claim: Soul gives life to the sensible cosmos without being partitioned into physical pieces.
claims.visual_goal: many living things participate in one undivided source
guardrails: Do not depict Soul as a stock of energy consumed by bodies.

claims.claim: The soul turns its contemplation toward Intellect as its source and means of perfection.
claims.visual_goal: alignment of attention toward Intellect, not physical upward travel
guardrails: Do not turn the orientation of thought into literal travel through space.

comparison_tests.different: G03 posits destination-specific radiations; B01 posits seven divine rays/builders; not equivalent physical carriers

comparison_tests.common: a dependent plurality or subordinate principle with a supreme source
comparison_tests.different: Bailey has seven differentiations; Plotinus asserts atemporal grounding of Intellect and denies loss from the One

comparison_tests.common: one term structurally depends on another
comparison_tests.different: G04 is functional nourishment using a carrier; P02 is existence-grounding without carrier or depletion

comparison_tests.common: a higher principle bears on the characteristics of lower forms
comparison_tests.different: B03 confers differentiated ray qualities; P03 connects the presence of life to indivisible Soul

rejection_tests.error: P01 shown with glowing particles leaving the One
rejection_tests.why: imports time and physical transfer into atemporal grounding

rejection_tests.error: B01 seven rays shown as seven chunks removed from one source
rejection_tests.why: implies depletion unsupported by the mapped claim

rejection_tests.error: G03 and B01 collapsed because both use rays/radiations
rejection_tests.why: lexical similarity is not operator equivalence

rejection_tests.error: All upward/descending orientation treated as literal location
rejection_tests.why: hierarchy, valuation, causation and spatial position differ
